full_name: Kacie Dragan | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2023–2024 Social Sciences Arleen Carlson and Edna Nelson Graduate Fellow Harvard University
bio: Kacie Dragan is a doctoral candidate in the Harvard University PhD Program in Health Policy whose research draws on theories and methods from both economics and epidemiology to study how health systems interact with the broader social safety net to influence well-being, especially in the housing and family services sectors and among children with chronic diseases.
